services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: South Port Marine operates at 14 Ocean Street in South Portland, with new and pre-owned boats for sale. Not just a sales lot. The yard runs a certified service shop, 170 wet slips, indoor heated storage, a parts counter, and boat rentals, all from one waterfront property. Located at 14 Ocean Street on the South Portland waterfront, our full-service boatyard and marina serves boaters across Casco Bay and the southern Maine coast. In-season Sun - Wed: 8 AM - 6 PM Thu - Sat: 8 AM - 8 PM Off-season Mon - Fri: 9 AM - 5 PM Winter weekends Reduced hours Offshore center consoles and dual consoles from bay boats up to 29-foot deep-V

blurb: South Port Marine offers boat rentals, full-service boat maintenance and repair, marina slips, and indoor heated storage. They service engines, mechanical and electrical systems, rigging, and provide haul-out and launch services. Rentals include Sea Pro center console boats for half-day and full-day trips on Casco Bay.

quotes.author: Mark Reardon
quotes.text: Brought an old Mercury marine outboard here after I exhausted my own repair abilities. They did an outstanding job and I later noticed they fixed a few other issues with the engine I didn’t even ask about. Larry is the man. Great Mercury parts availability and prices too.

quotes.author: sherry kinney
quotes.text: Such great service after an awful experience at Fore Points Marina Mandy went out of her way to accommodate us as well as our guests All the amenities included with dock stay ….we will be back

quotes.author: Diane Stearns
quotes.text: Gus did a great job moving our sailboat, and we look forward to having him move our boat in the spring. He is professional and talented.

quotes.author: Zoë Ferris
quotes.text: We needed a dock early in the season and the marina team was able to get us in at the end of March. Nice facilities. Great fish tank!
